reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I confirmed I'd noted the change: the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is for 100 seats, not the 261 she posted in #north-team this morning.

There are still no Quarrendon account files in the share, so I had nothing to check the new number against or update. Her 261 message in #north-team, and my thread reply confirming it, are still the only record. Dana and Marcus will keep seeing 261 there. I offered to post the correction in that thread, but I haven't, because she said no action was needed.
